concepts.definition: The best alternative to a negotiated agreement: what you do if no deal is reached.
The zone of possible agreement: the overlap of both sides' acceptable ranges.
Assuming that the other side's interests are opposed to yours on every issue.

questions.q: What is the difference between a position and an interest?
questions.a: A position is what a party says it wants, an interest is the reason behind it.

questions.q: How does the fixed-pie assumption harm a negotiation?
questions.a: Negotiators miss trades that serve both sides, since they assume the interests are opposed.
